calls.title: Correct seven triage titles?
calls.text: Four whole-college Credit by Exam exhibits carry one course's title (Plant Propagation among them), and CompTIA A+, Network+ and Server+ sit under Security+, from the 2026-11-01 triage.

next_step.title: The Exhibits queue lenses, then the Commons CCR

changes.text: Exhibits opens a Queue: six lenses in the ruled order over the lists it already holds, with a Blocked on Sky line (cpl-project-tracker#2933).

The four El Camino CompTIA exhibits were read under your rule from Sheet 167: each is El Camino's own course, filed in MAP as Credit by Exam, so it is a course exam and the college stays its issuer, as the records already say. Nothing was rewritten.
Add your credential is live (#2860): a search that finds nothing offers Add it; nothing a visitor types shows until a reviewer verifies it in the Exhibits Requests view (DR-32).
CPL Pathways brings the Credential Catalog in: a Credentials card, a Programs or Credentials switch, and a college's recommended credentials it could adopt (#2863, open).

The Credential Catalog's badges, the Recommendations filter and a college's first view of the recommended credentials it could adopt (#2856).
